items.name: Costochondritis pain is reproduced by pressing
Angina pain isn't reproduced by pressing
Shortness of breath or cold sweat is a warning sign
Never wait it out at home if unclear

closing.headline: Never just wait it out at home when chest pain is hard to tell apart.
closing.tip: Check the location, whether pressing reproduces it, and any other symptoms.
closing.cta: If it comes with shortness of breath or spreads to the arm, go to the ER now.
